items.title: Beyond Explicit Edges: Robust Reasoning over Noisy and Sparse Knowledge Graphs
items.title_zh: 超越显式边：在噪声与稀疏知识图谱上的鲁棒推理
items.summary: INSES is a dynamic GraphRAG framework that couples LLM-guided navigation, which prunes noise and steers exploration, with embedding-based similarity expansion to recover hidden links in noisy or sparse knowledge graphs. A lightweight router sends simple queries to naive RAG and escalates complex ones to INSES, and the system performs favorably against RAG and GraphRAG baselines, notably on the MINE benchmark.

items.title: The Reasoning Bottleneck in Graph-RAG: Structured Prompting and Context Compression for Multi-Hop QA
items.title_zh: Graph-RAG 中的推理瓶颈：面向多跳问答的结构化提示与上下文压缩
items.summary: Evaluating KET-RAG on three multi-hop QA benchmarks, the authors find that 77% to 91% of questions have the gold answer in the retrieved context yet accuracy is only 35% to 78%, with 73% to 84% of errors traced to reasoning failures. SPARQL chain-of-thought prompting and graph-walk compression improve accuracy, and with question-type routing an augmented Llama-8B matches or exceeds an unaugmented Llama-70B at roughly 12x lower cost.

items.title: ToolFlood: Beyond Selection -- Hiding Valid Tools from LLM Agents via Semantic Covering
items.title_zh: ToolFlood：通过语义覆盖向 LLM agent 隐藏有效工具
items.summary: ToolFlood attacks the tool-retrieval layer of LLM agents by injecting a few tools whose metadata is positioned to span many user queries in embedding space, pushing benign tools out of the agent's context. On the ToolBench catalog it reports up to 95% attack success at roughly a 1% injection rate.

items.title: An Alternative Trajectory for Generative AI
items.title_zh: 生成式 AI 的另一条发展轨迹
items.summary: The position paper argues that scaling monolithic models is colliding with energy, water and data constraints, and proposes domain-specific superintelligence built by first constructing explicit symbolic abstractions such as knowledge graphs, ontologies and formal logic. It envisions societies of small domain models routed by orchestration agents, moving capability from data centers to on-device experts.

items.title: Clinician input steers AI toward accurate and harmful recommendations
items.title_zh: 临床医生的输入会引导 AI 给出准确但也有害的建议
items.summary: Using 61 NEJM Case Records and 21 reasoning variants from eight models, the study finds that clinician context raises LLM-clinician concordance and improves correct final-diagnosis inclusion by a mean 20.4 points, while adversarial context degrades performance in 14 models. Inference-time scaling reduces harmful echoing of clinician-introduced recommendations across WHO harm-severity tiers.

items.title: The GELATO Dataset for Legislative NER
items.title_zh: GELATO：面向立法文本命名实体识别的数据集
items.summary: GELATO is a dataset of U.S. House and Senate bills from the 118th Congress annotated with a two-level named-entity-recognition ontology. The authors fine-tune BERT and RoBERTa for first-level prediction and use prompted LLMs for the second level.

items.title: A Multi-Agent Perception-Action Alliance for Efficient Long Video Reasoning
items.title_zh: 面向高效长视频推理的多智能体感知-行动联盟
items.summary: A4VL runs a multi-round perception-action exploration loop with a team of VLM agents that extract query-specific clues from sampled frames, align them to relevant video blocks, and cross-review one another before deciding whether to continue or answer. It reports gains over 18 VLMs and 11 long-video methods on five VideoQA benchmarks with lower inference latency.

items.title: nikmcfly/MiroFish-Offline
items.title_zh: MiroFish-Offline：离线多智能体模拟引擎
items.summary: An English fork of MiroFish that provides an offline multi-agent simulation and prediction engine built on a local Neo4j graph database and Ollama stack.

items.title: jackwener/OpenCLI
items.summary: OpenCLI is a JavaScript project that turns any website into a command-line interface and lets an AI agent use the browser session the user is already logged into.

items.title: AgriChat: A Multimodal Large Language Model for Agriculture Image Understanding
items.title_zh: AgriChat：面向农业图像理解的多模态大语言模型
items.summary: AgriChat is a specialized multimodal LLM trained on AgriMM, a benchmark built by a Vision-to-Verified-Knowledge pipeline that combines visual captioning with web-augmented scientific retrieval to ground annotations in phytopathological literature. AgriMM contains more than 3,000 agricultural classes and over 607k visual question-answer pairs, and AgriChat is reported to outperform other open-source models on internal and external benchmarks.
